findings.title: OPS-029's generated tool reference was not regenerated: the diff's only hunk to the file touches the hand-written "## What it runs" list, while the generated block still says "four" and omits npm ci.
findings.evidence: docs/08-governance/OPS-029-run-review-checks.md: generated block (<!-- generated:tool-reference:start --> … :end -->, lines 103-147 in the current checkout) untouched by the diff, although tools/run_review_checks.py's module docstring (the generator's source) was updated (diff lines 181-191).

findings.title: No evidence in the runner output that `npm run build`, `npm run lint` or `npm test` pass (or correctly fail) on this diff, because ts/ dependencies were never installed in this review run.
findings.evidence: ts/eslint.config.js, ts/package.json, verification entries 2-4: 02-verification.txt `sh: 1: tsc: not found`; 03-verification.txt eslint 6.4.0 (stray global) "couldn't find a configuration file"; 04-verification.txt `sh: 1: vitest: not found`; 01-setup.txt shows only `uv sync --extra dev`, no `npm ci`.
findings.consequence: This blocks judging the phase's central claims (clean lint baseline, CI gate behavior) from the evidence provided.
